## 更新 · What's new

- 全平台：「公网设备组」与「中继连接」合并为统一的「中继设置」，以两个选项卡切换；「局域网设置」只保留局域网。
  All platforms: relay device groups and the relay connection now live together under one "Relay settings" page with two tabs; LAN settings stay LAN-only.
- 全平台：中继设置提供 common-relay 公开项目入口（Mac 直接打开，Android / iOS / Windows 复制链接），方便自行部署中继服务器。
  All platforms: Relay settings link to the public common-relay project (opened on Mac, copied on Android / iOS / Windows) so you can self-host a relay server.
- Mac：「保持唤醒」成为工具模块的独立页面；预设高亮跟随当前会话，「直到应用退出」切换目标应用后会正确结束。
  Mac: Keep Awake gets its own Tools page; preset highlighting follows the running session, and "until an app quits" now ends correctly after switching the target app.
